title: Turning the Party below the Ridge
story: The party reached the last scree below the ridge as the wind began to throw ice. The map promised an hour to the hut, and the stronger walkers wanted to push on before darkness caught them on the slope. Noor watched the person at the rear rather than the skyline. His steps had shortened and his hands were slow on the poles. The hour assumed a pace the group no longer had. She turned them while they could still place their feet with care, and they regained the trees before the squall. The hut could wait until morning. A tired mistake on that slope would not have been forgiven.

vocabulary.definition: The high crest they had not yet reached
Sticks used to steady a walker
The speed at which the group was moving
A sudden violent burst of wind and weather
The inclined ground under their feet

quiz.question: Whose movement told Noor more than the skyline?
options: The person at the rear
A guide waiting among the trees
Only the strongest walker
The hut keeper on the ridge
quiz.explanation: Noor watched the person at the rear rather than the skyline.
quiz.supportingSentence: Noor watched the person at the rear rather than the skyline.

quiz.question: What did the stronger walkers want to do?
options: Push on before darkness caught them on the slope
Camp on the stones until dawn
Send Noor down the ridge alone
Leave the map with the last walker
quiz.correctAnswer: Push on before darkness caught them on the slope
quiz.explanation: They wanted to push on before darkness caught them on the slope.
quiz.supportingSentence: The map promised an hour to the hut, and the stronger walkers wanted to push on before darkness caught them on the slope.

quiz.question: Why does the map's hour stop being a safe guide?
options: It assumes a speed the tired group has already lost
It shows a hut that was never built
It forbids anyone to turn around
It was drawn for travel by boat
quiz.correctAnswer: It assumes a speed the tired group has already lost
quiz.explanation: The hour assumed a pace the group no longer had, so the map's timing no longer fits.
quiz.supportingSentence: The hour assumed a pace the group no longer had.

quiz.question: What does squall mean as they turn downhill?
options: A sudden violent burst of weather
The hut marked on the map
A stick used on loose stone
The band of trees below
quiz.correctAnswer: A sudden violent burst of weather
quiz.explanation: A squall is a sudden violent burst of weather, and they reach the trees before it arrives.
quiz.supportingSentence: She turned them while they could still place their feet with care, and they regained the trees before the squall.

quiz.question: Why mention the wish to beat the darkness?
options: To set up the hurry she rejects once the rear walker slows
To prove the hut had already collapsed
To blame the rear walker for carrying no map
To argue that the party should divide
quiz.correctAnswer: To set up the hurry she rejects once the rear walker slows
quiz.explanation: The wish establishes the pressure that the slowed rear walker then makes unsafe.
quiz.supportingSentence: The map promised an hour to the hut, and the stronger walkers wanted to push on before darkness caught them on the slope.
